svg.title: The fleet: Thompson draws for every session, one card or none
svg.text: The fleet: Thompson draws for every session, one card or none
Each session's strategy, model, settings and card are drawn from what earlier attempts showed; sessions with no card are the control a card is measured against.
(a) BEFORE EVERY SESSION OF A PROVER
(b) ONE CARD PER SESSION, OR NONE
(c) MEASURED AGAINST THE CONTROL, NEVER TRUSTED

at least 8 observations on each side and P(effect < 0)
above 0.9: the fleet leaves the card out of the draw.
Nothing is deleted; more control sessions can bring it back
Read, by family and by card
harness heuristics stats RUN_DIR: no model is called
The control of a card's buckets is standardized to the card's own mix of buckets,
so a card drawn mostly in hard buckets is not set against easy ones.
